frontmatter.description: Use when code changes affect setup, architecture, API, security or operations docs in docs/ or README.md.

frontmatter.name: graphify-repository-analysis
frontmatter.description: Use for codebase architecture, dependency, impact or 'what calls X' questions; query the Graphify knowledge graph (graphify-out/) before grepping or reading many files.

frontmatter.name: javascript-backend
frontmatter.description: Use when implementing or changing Node.js JavaScript backend code in server/ (Express routes, services, middleware). Not TypeScript.

frontmatter.description: Use when adding or changing Mongoose models, indexes, retention, transactions or migrations in server/src/models.

frontmatter.name: multi-agent-orchestration
frontmatter.description: Use when a task needs more than one specialist agent, parallel work, or a dependency-ordered plan.

frontmatter.name: nextjs-development
frontmatter.description: Use when building or changing the Next.js/React web app in web/ (pages, components, data fetching, live graph UI).

frontmatter.name: product-requirements
frontmatter.description: Use when turning an approved request into a PRD, user stories or acceptance criteria.

frontmatter.name: company-strategy

frontmatter.name: founder-planning
frontmatter.description: Use for founder briefs, prioritized objectives, decision logs, business roadmaps, risk registers or weekly execution reports.

frontmatter.name: incident-response
frontmatter.description: Use during a suspected security incident or production outage to triage, contain and document.

frontmatter.name: production-readiness
frontmatter.description: Use before declaring a phase or release production-ready: security, recovery, monitoring, backups, docs.

frontmatter.name: project-discovery
frontmatter.description: Use at the start of any task in an unfamiliar area of DATYLUNE AI OS to locate the relevant subsystem, files and tests before planning or editing.

frontmatter.name: secure-code-review
frontmatter.description: Use when reviewing a diff or module for security defects: authz, tenant isolation, injection, path traversal, secrets, unsafe execution.

frontmatter.name: task-checklist-maintenance
frontmatter.description: Use after every meaningful task to update docs/IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKLIST.md and docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md with honest status, evidence and token usage.

frontmatter.name: testing-and-validation
frontmatter.description: Use when writing, running or reporting tests, lint and builds, or deciding whether acceptance criteria are met.

frontmatter.name: executive-reporting
frontmatter.description: Use when producing executive, KPI, operating, cost or weekly reports from recorded DATYLUNE data.
